{
  "name": "ruflo-ruvllm",
  "description": "RuVLLM local inference with chat formatting (Claude/GPT/Gemini/Ollama/Cohere), model configuration, MicroLoRA fine-tuning, and SONA real-time adaptation. As a mod (ADR-445): a guard that keeps secrets out of adapters and the pattern router, /ruvllm-mod, and a status file the console shows",
  "version": "0.3.3",
  "author": {
    "name": "ruvnet",
    "url": "https://github.com/ruvnet"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "ruflo",
    "ruvllm",
    "llm",
    "inference",
    "microlora",
    "fine-tuning",
    "mcp",
    "local-inference",
    "chat-templates",
    "mod",
    "function-hooks",
    "guard"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "guard": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Secret guard",
      "description": "Refuse calls to this plugin's write tools that hold a key, token or password.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  }
}
